source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/cbse-g10.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/CurriculumMain27/SecPart1/Maths_SecP1X_2026-27.pdf https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/Circulars/2026/14_Circular_2026.pdf https://cbseacademic.nic.in/curriculum_2027.html https://ncert.nic.in/pdf/announcement/notices/Advisory_ncertbooks.pdf. Notes: TEXTBOOK: For 2026-27 Class X still uses the rationalised NCERT 'Mathematics: Textbook for Class X' (14 chapters; Constructions removed). NCERT said in March 2026 that new NCF-SE books for Grades 10 and 11 come only from 2027-28; I read this in news reports because the NCERT advisory PDF is blocked to the fetch tool. STANDARD vs BASIC: CBSE offers Mathematics Standard (041) and Mathematics Basic (241). They have the same syllabus, the same textbook and the same 80+20 mark structure; only the question-paper design differs. Standard: Remembering/Understanding 43 marks (54%), Applying 19 (24%), Analysing/Evaluating/Creating 18 (22%). Basic: 60 (75%), 12 (15%), 8 (10%). This file covers both; no outcome is Standard-only. UNIT WEIGHTS (theory 80 marks, 3 hours): Number Systems 6, Algebra 20, Coordinate Geometry 6, Geometry 15, Trigonometry 12, Mensuration 10, Statistics and Probability 11. Internal assessment 20: pen-paper test and multiple assessment 10 (5+5), portfolio 5, lab practical 5. The extracted text of the 2026-27 document gave no period counts.
